title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
summary: While textual frequency has been validated as relevant to human cognition in reading speed, its relatedness to Large Language Models (LLMs) is seldom studied. We propose a novel research direction in terms of textual data frequency, which is an understudied topic, to the best of our knowledge. Our framework is composed of three units. First, this paper proposes Textual Frequency Law (TFL), which indicates that frequent textual data should be preferred for LLMs for both prompting and fine-tuning.…
description: Textual Frequency Law, Textual Frequency Distillation, Curriculum Textual Frequency Training, Large Language Models, prompting
developer_name: Hongyuan Adam Lu, Z. L., Victor Wei, Zefan Zhang, Zhao Hong et al. (8 authors)

analysis.detail_brief: While textual frequency has been validated as relevant to human cognition in reading speed, its relatedness to Large Language Models (LLMs) is seldom studied. We propose a novel research direction in terms of textual data frequency, which is an understudied topic, to the best of our knowledge. Our framework is composed of three units. First, this paper proposes Textual Frequency Law (TFL), which indicates that frequent textual data should be preferred for LLMs for both prompting and fine-tuning.

platform_copies.reddit_body_en: A recent trend caught my eye: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models. Instead of reposting it as news, I'd frame it through Tencent Cloud scenario and focus on research takeaway. Would that make the discussion more useful for developers?

summary_cn: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models：虽然文本频率已被证实与人类的阅读速度认知相关，但其与大型语言模型 (LLM) 的相关性却很少被研究。据我们所知，我们在文本数据频率方面提出了一个新颖的研究方向，这是一个尚未充分研究的主题。
